title: Format elapsed seconds as days and a zero-padded clock
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: Integer divmod gives exact days and a two-digit clock at any size, and bool, non-int and negative inputs raise the errors the brief names.
It is written in JavaScript, while the brief asks for a Python function.
timedelta tops out at 999999999 days, so format_elapsed(10**15) raises OverflowError instead of returning "11574074074d 01:46:40".
Floor division and modulo give each field exactly, the exact type test rejects bool and other types, and negatives raise ValueError.
